summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience in TensorRT deployment, CUDA kernel engineering, and deep learning inference optimization. Engineered CUDA C++17 kernels delivering 1.5–2× speedup via memory coalescing and STL-managed buffers; deployed TensorRT-accelerated YOLO inference on Jetson at ~18 FPS. Background spans modern C++, performance benchmarking, model compression, and systems programming across edge and HPC platforms.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 detection models; improved classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5% via dataset augmentation and hyperparameter tuning; deployed in a consumer mobile app.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing improvements and model tuning in PyTorch.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 MRI data; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; restructured task distribution and delivered the full pipeline within the 6-week window.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++17 kernels using STL-managed host buffers, memory coalescing, and constant memory for filter weights to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU and 1.5–2× speedup in convolution ops with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed TensorRT-accelerated YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson; implemented two-link IK in C++ on Arduino driving five servos with contact-aware grasping via ToF sensing.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo crosstalk, rolling-shutter depth); achieved 100% pick reliability across 10 trials at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via 8-bit quantization; benchmarked the quantized model across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; characterized accuracy-efficiency trade-offs for edge inference.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Ran YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object detection; transmitted control commands to STM32 over UART with interrupt-driven PWM servo control and FreeRTOS mutex-protected shared memory.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 Transformer in PyTorch from scratch — multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, and layer norm with weight tying; trained with a custom loop and perplexity evaluation to validate architecture fundamentals.
